card.name: Words just before 'account' in banking
card.fires_on: Small words and modifiers right before an expected 'account', such as 'my', 'an', 'bank' or 'savings', in talk about salary, deposits and bank accounts.

modes.label: Determiner before account
modes.description: A word like my, an or a, where 'account' is the likely next word.
modes.example: When I get paid, my salary goes into<< my>> cheque account.

modes.label: Bank modifier
modes.description: A word like bank or savings that directly precedes 'accounts'.
modes.example: the balances of your<< bank>> accounts.

modes.label: Preposition into a bank
modes.description: Words like into or on where money goes to an account.
modes.example: I get my salary paid<< into>> a bank account because I do not want

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the word 'account' or 'accounts' next.
card.plain: It fires when the next word is likely to be 'account', as in a bank account.
